title: Kong DB-less: strip_path + service path, strip_path=false, methods, hosts
claims: strip_path=true with service path /v1 forwards /api/items?x=1 as /v1/items?x=1
strip_path=false forwards the full request path unchanged
a GET-only route does not forward POST
a hosts-restricted route does not forward other Host values
unmatched paths are not forwarded (no broad fallback)
not_claimed: Kong string-prefix matching of /api against /apix (not probed here)
Exact status code for a method miss: Kong answers 404, Ferrum allowed_methods answers 405; only non-forwarding is asserted
Bare /api with strip_path (empty remainder) joining behavior
source_semantics: Kong 3.x routing (path_handling v0 default): stripped remainder is appended to service.path; strip_path defaults to true and is set explicitly; methods/hosts restrict matching and a miss yields 404 'no Route matched'. Documentation-inferred unless the upstream differential runs.
